Explain the example for add page metadata

blocks.text: Metadata gives a page a browser title and search description. Static values can be exported from a server page file.

Use a Next.js App Router project. Save files at the paths shown. For these static examples, use output: "export" in next.config.ts and npm run build. They need Next.js tools and do not run in this playground.

blocks.title: Add page metadata

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: The exported metadata object describes the page title and description; it belongs in a server page or layout file.

blocks.text: The browser tab uses Books | Reading Club. The page includes the description metadata.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not export metadata from a file marked use client. Put metadata in a server page or layout.
